title: The evolving nexus: sovereigns, banks and NBFIs
title_zh: 演变中的关联：主权、银行与非银行金融机构
authors: Stefan Avdjiev, Bryan Hardy, Maximilian Jager
official: 官方在线 2026-07-16 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Focus Historically, banks' holdings of sovereign debt have been key drivers of the co-movement between sovereign and bank risks. Recent years have seen an increase in banks' links with non-bank financial institutions (NBFIs) as well as a greater presence of NBFIs in sovereign debt markets. These developments have the potential to broaden the classical sovereign-bank nexus into a sovereign-bank-NBFI nexus. We examine the degree to which this has taken place, using European bank-level data along with global country-level data.
abstract_zh: 历史上，银行持有的主权债务一直是主权风险与银行风险联动的主要驱动因素。近年来，银行与非银行金融机构（NBFIs）的联系日益紧密，同时NBFIs在主权债务市场中的参与度显著提升。这些发展可能将传统的主权-银行关联扩展为主权-银行-NBFI三重关联。我们利用欧洲银行层面的数据及全球国家层面的数据，考察了这一转变的实现程度。

title: Anecdotes or Statistics?
official: 官方在线 2026-07-11 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Why might persuaders favor anecdotes over aggregate statistics? We study a policy advocate choosing between them to persuade a diverse, skeptical citizenry with demographically correlated outcomes. Two forces compete: an umbrella effect, by which everyone responds more strongly to the statistic, and a wild-card effect, by which the anecdote's higher variance makes favorable realizations likelier. The anecdote prevails under sufficiently narrow consensus, so its appeal has a rational, informational basis. When breadth of aggregation is flexible, the optimal evidence is a local statistic that aggregates over a broader subpopulation than the minimal winning coalition, though almost anecdotal as consensus narrows.
abstract_zh: 为何说服者更偏爱轶事而非总体统计数据？我们研究了一位政策倡导者在两者间的选择，其目标是说服一个具有人口统计相关结果的多元化、持怀疑态度的公民群体。两种效应相互竞争：一是“伞效应”，即每个人对统计数据的反应更为强烈；二是“野牌效应”，即轶事的高方差使得有利结果更可能出现。当共识足够狭窄时，轶事占据上风，因此其吸引力具有理性的信息基础。当聚合范围灵活时，最优证据是一种局部统计量，它聚合了比最小获胜联盟更广泛的子群体，但随着共识变窄，这种统计量几乎接近于轶事。

title: A Demand Theory of the Price Level
abstract: Heterogeneous agent incomplete markets models offer a new perspective on price and inflation determination. In contrast to complete markets, the price level is determined from the asset‐market clearing condition. Fiscal and monetary policy then jointly and uniquely determine the finite steady‐state price level and the inflation rate, including in a steady state in which the nominal interest rate is constant. Fiscal policy can determine the long‐run inflation rate for a fiscal rule which sets the growth rate of nominal government debt, whereas both fiscal and monetary policy determine the long‐run inflation rate under different tax rules.
abstract_zh: 异质性主体不完全市场模型为价格与通胀决定提供了新视角。与完全市场不同，价格水平由资产市场出清条件决定。财政与货币政策共同且唯一地决定了有限稳态价格水平与通胀率，包括名义利率保持不变的稳态情形。在设定名义政府债务增长率的财政规则下，财政政策可决定长期通胀率；而在不同税收规则下，财政与货币政策共同决定长期通胀率。

title: Optimal Project Rejection and New Firm Start-Ups
title_zh: DP3429 最优项目拒绝与新创企业启动
official: 官方在线 2002-06-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Entrants are typically found to be more innovative than incumbent firms. Furthermore, these innovative ideas often originate with established firms in the industry. Therefore, the established firm and the start-up firm seem to select different types of projects. We claim that this is the consequence of their optimal project allocation mechanism, which depends on their comparative advantage. The start-up firm may seem more ?innovative? than the established firm may because the comparative advantage of the start-up firm is to commercialize ?innovative? projects, i.e. projects that do not fit with the established firms? existing assets. Our model integrates various facts found in the industrial organization literature about the entry rate, firm focus, firm growth, industry growth and innovation. We also obtain some counter-intuitive results such that a reduction in the cost of start-ups may actually slow down start-ups and that the firm may voluntarily give away the property rights to the inventions discovered within the firm.
abstract_zh: 通常发现，新进入企业比在位企业更具创新性。此外，这些创新想法往往源自行业内的成熟企业。因此，成熟企业与初创企业似乎选择了不同类型的项目。我们认为，这是其最优项目分配机制的结果，该机制取决于各自的比较优势。初创企业可能比成熟企业显得更具"创新性"，原因在于初创企业的比较优势在于将"创新性"项目商业化，即那些与成熟企业现有资产不匹配的项目。我们的模型整合了产业组织文献中关于进入率、企业专注度、企业成长、行业增长及创新的多种事实。我们还得出了一些反直觉的结论，例如降低初创企业的成本实际上可能减缓其发展速度，以及企业可能自愿放弃内部发明的产权。
